name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
coverage: Full tuition waiver + living stipend for the master's
fields: All ETH master's, including Computer Science and Data Science
eligibility: Excellent bachelor's (top ~10% of class), any nationality, applying to an ETH master's
english: TOEFL/IELTS/CAE/CPE, OR an official central-administration confirmation that the whole bachelor's was taught only in English (an MOI letter is accepted only if it meets this exact wording)
fitReason: CGPA 3.41 is probably below the top-10% bar. It is a long shot, but the MOI route makes it cheap to try (CHF 150 fee).
steps: Get a FAST registrar letter stating the whole BS was taught only in English, with stamp and signature
Prepare CV, motivation letter, 2 references and a research-proposal-style statement
Apply in the ETH portal 1–30 Nov 2026 and tick ESOP
Pay CHF 150

name: EPFL Master's Excellence Fellowship
coverage: Stipend (reports differ on whether tuition is also covered)
fields: All EPFL master's, including CS and Data Science
eligibility: Outstanding academic record; applied by the December deadline
english: Per EPFL master's rules (check programme); MOI acceptance unconfirmed
fitReason: This is very selective. Apply in the December round only if he also applies to ETH.
steps: Apply to an EPFL MSc in the mid-Nov – 15 Dec 2026 window
Tick the fellowship option in the application
Decisions come by late March 2027

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
host: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
coverage: Monthly allowance, return travel, health insurance, cultural activities (tuition not covered)
fields: Engineering sciences incl. digital sciences/AI, plus others
eligibility: Non-French, age up to 29 for master's; must be nominated by a French institution
english: Set by the nominating institution (many need IELTS; some accept MOI)
deadline: Institutions submit by 6 Jan 2027; internal school deadlines Oct–Nov 2026 (e.g. Université Paris Cité 12–29 Oct 2026)
fitReason: Pakistanis are eligible and a CS/AI profile with industry LLM work is relevant. The bottleneck is getting nominated, which happens soon, so contact target masters NOW.
steps: Shortlist French masters that nominate Eiffel candidates
Check each school's internal Eiffel deadline (Oct–Dec 2026)
Apply to the master's and request nomination
School submits by 6 Jan 2027; results about late Mar 2027
Then do Campus France EEF and the visa

name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships Program
coverage: Living allowance for 10 months + travel/visa allowance; tuition not automatically waived
fields: All Paris-Saclay masters incl. AI, Data Science, Computer Science
eligibility: International students admitted to a Paris-Saclay master's; selected by the programme coordinator
english: Per programme; some M1/M2 in AI accept an MOI letter
deadline: Coordinator selection about 25 Mar 2027 (2026 cycle: 25 Mar 2026); apply to the master's well before
fitReason: €10k plus low French fees (≈€3,950) makes the budget work. It is awarded via admission, with no separate test, and an AI/LLM work profile fits Saclay's AI masters.
steps: Apply on the Paris-Saclay Inception portal to M1/M2 AI or Data Science (Jan–Mar 2027)
Mention the scholarship in the motivation letter
Coordinator nominates by about 25 Mar 2027
Campus France EEF and visa

name: Université Grenoble Alpes / MIAI Cluster AI master's scholarships
coverage: Living allowance for M1/M2 in AI-related masters
fields: AI, Data Science, MoSIG, Applied Maths
eligibility: International students admitted to eligible UGA masters, based on merit
english: Per programme (MoSIG usually B2; check MOI)
fitReason: Grenoble is strong in AI and cheap to live in, which suits an applied-AI profile.
steps: Apply to UGA MoSIG / Data Science / AI master via eCandidat
Check the scholarship checkbox or separate call
Campus France EEF

name: Université Côte d'Azur IDEX / EUR DS4H master's scholarships
host: Université Côte d'Azur (IDEX JEDI, EUR DS4H)
coverage: Monthly allowance for international master's students
fields: Data Science & AI, Computer Science (DS4H graduate school)
eligibility: International students admitted to a DS4H master's, based on merit
fitReason: MSc Data Science & AI in Nice is taught in English and has a scholarship path. Check MOI acceptance.
steps: Apply to the UCA DS4H master's
Apply for the EUR/IDEX scholarship in the same cycle
Campus France EEF

name: Institut Polytechnique de Paris Master's scholarships
host: IP Paris (École Polytechnique, Télécom Paris, ENSTA, ENSAE)
coverage: Partial or full tuition and/or living allowance
eligibility: Excellent international applicants to IP Paris master's
deadline: First admission rounds about Dec 2026 – Feb 2027 (scholarship considered in early rounds)
fitReason: IP Paris is highly selective, and its tuition for non-EU is much higher than the universities'.
steps: Apply in round 1 on the IP Paris portal
Tick the scholarship request

name: Master Mind Scholarships (Flemish Government)
host: Flemish Government via Flemish universities (KU Leuven, Ghent, UAntwerp, VUB, Hasselt)
amount: About €10,000+/yr + tuition waiver (2027/28 amount not final)
fields: All fields incl. AI and Computer Science
eligibility: All nationalities except Russia; Pakistan is eligible (general pool, not a priority country); degree from outside Flanders; excellent grades
deadline: University internal deadlines about Feb–Mar 2027 (2026 cycle about 1 Feb – 31 Mar 2026)
fitReason: It would make KU Leuven AI affordable, but it is competitive and CGPA 3.41 is middling. The work experience helps.
steps: Apply to KU Leuven / Ghent master's by about 1 Mar 2027
Submit the Master Mind application via the host university
University ranks and nominates; results about June

name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
host: Dutch Ministry of Education + Dutch institutions
eligibility: Non-EEA nationals (Pakistan eligible) who have not studied in NL before
english: IELTS/TOEFL per university (MOI generally not accepted)
fitReason: €5k barely dents €20k+ Dutch tuition; not enough for this budget.
steps: Apply to a participating university's MSc
Submit the NL Scholarship form via that university by its deadline

name: TU Delft Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
fields: All TU Delft MSc incl. Computer Science
eligibility: Non-EEA; bachelor's GPA at least 80% of scale maximum; admitted to a TU Delft MSc
deadline: About 1 Dec 2026 (apply to the MSc first)
fitReason: 3.41/4 is roughly 85%, so the GPA bar may be met on paper, but it is extremely competitive and IELTS is required.
steps: Apply to the TU Delft MSc by 1 Dec 2026
Submit the scholarship application before the deadline

name: Finland Scholarship / Finnish university tuition waivers (Aalto, Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, LUT)
coverage: 50% or 100% tuition waiver; Finland Scholarship adds a first-year relocation grant
fields: CS, Data Science, AI, Software Engineering
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying applicants admitted to English master's; merit based
english: IELTS/TOEFL/PTE mostly required; English-medium exemptions are country-limited (Pakistan generally not)
fitReason: A 100% waiver plus €9,600 funds fits the budget and comes with a 2-year post-study permit. It needs IELTS.
steps: Book IELTS before Dec 2026
Apply on studyinfo.fi in January 2027 and tick the scholarship
Upload documents by the deadline

name: Stipendium Hungaricum (via HEC Pakistan)
host: Hungarian Government / Tempus Public Foundation; HEC is the Pakistani sending partner
coverage: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend, dormitory or housing allowance, medical insurance
amount: Free tuition + about HUF 43,700/month stipend + housing (HUF 40,000/month or dorm) + insurance
fields: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science (HEC-approved field list)
eligibility: Pakistani/AJK nationals; HEC fields and age/CGPA rules per HEC call; 100 master's seats in 2026-27
english: Set by the host university; many accept an English-medium bachelor's certificate (MOI), others need IELTS/TOEFL or an interview
deadline: Expected 15 Jan 2027 on both the HEC and SH portals (2026-27 was 15 Jan 2026, 16:00 PKT)
fitReason: This is fully funded with a Pakistan quota, and an MOI letter is accepted by many hosts. It is the cheapest credible EU route; weaker local jobs but EU experience.
steps: Pick up to 2 programmes on the SH portal (DreamApply) whose English rule accepts MOI
Get HEC degree attestation and an MOI letter from FAST
Submit on the SH portal AND the HEC portal before 15 Jan 2027
HEC nominates in Feb; university interviews Mar–May; results June

name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
coverage: Full tuition waiver + stipend for one year
fields: All fields at Irish HEIs incl. CS/AI
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA; offer (or application) for a master's at an eligible Irish HEI; 60 awards
english: Per university (usually IELTS 6.5; some accept English-medium degree)
deadline: 2027 call expected to open about late Jan 2027 and close about early-mid Mar 2027 (2026: 29 Jan – 12 Mar 2026)
fitReason: It makes Ireland (English jobs 5/5, 2-year Stamp 1G) affordable, but only 60 awards worldwide.
steps: Apply to 1–2 Irish CS/AI MSc programmes in Nov–Jan
Apply on the HEA portal when the call opens (about Jan 2027)
Results about June 2027

name: Guillaume Dupaix International Master's Scholarship (University of Luxembourg)
deadline: Last cycle 24 Mar 2026; expect about Mar 2027
fitReason: Combined with €400/semester fees it would make Luxembourg affordable.
steps: Apply to MICS in the non-EU window (about Feb–Mar 2027)
Apply for the scholarship in the same period

name: University of Tartu master's tuition waivers
amount: Waives €7,200/yr tuition (about 10 places for all citizenships in CS)
fitReason: Estonia has the strongest English-only tech jobs among cheap options. A waiver makes total cost about €10k/yr.
steps: Apply via DreamApply by the non-EU deadline
Waiver is automatic for top-ranked applicants

name: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals (Sweden)
coverage: Tuition, living stipend, travel grant, insurance
eligibility: Citizens of 34 listed countries ONLY; Pakistan is NOT on the list (verified on si.se, Oct 2026)
deadline: Not applicable to Pakistan (portal about Feb 2027 for eligible countries)
fitReason: Pakistan is ineligible; listed so it isn't chased.
steps: Not eligible
